--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Label passes whose output arrives in one buffered event (generation.output_buffered)
+---
+Replaces ^4g1pdrz. Decision 2026-10-23: no change to mlx-swift-lm. Its allowed-tool path sends a tool-call-only pass (no reasoning) as one output event at the end of generation, and its public API carries no prefill timing, so Router cannot observe the first token of such a pass. Today those calls record first_token_seen=false with nothing to say why (45 of 105 calls in router-telemetry-16), which looks like lost data.
+
+Label them instead. A pass whose output reached Router as exactly one output event (PassOutputRelay saw a first output and no second) is buffered: its first-token time is unobservable, not missing.
+
+- [ ] Failing test: a pass with a single output event records output_buffered=true and first_token_seen=false; a streamed pass records output_buffered=false with its time to first token; a pass with no output event records neither as buffered
+- [ ] GenerationCallUsage carries the flag (public, documented beside timeToFirstToken / firstTokenSeen)
+- [ ] The generationCall transcript/journal event records it (TranscriptEvent, beside firstTokenSeen)
+- [ ] The generation span gets attribute generation.output_buffered (RouterTelemetry.AttributeKey, beside generation.first_token_seen)
+- [ ] Docs (GenerationCallUsage, RouterTelemetry, and ARCHITECTURE.md / session.md wherever first_token_seen is described) say time to first token is measured only on streamed passes, and buffered passes are excluded by design
\ No newline at end of file
